annotations.title: Check a site for WebMCP tools

description: Check a website LIVE for a WebMCP declaration: robots.txt first, then the page and its first-party scripts. The step that ran the page in a browser is switched off, so whether a tool registers is reported as could_not_ask (runtime_registration). Returns one of: declared, not_declared, could_not_ask, or excluded when the site's robots.txt refuses AI input. could_not_ask is a distinct answer and is never reported as a no. Reads only the site named plus published population figures — it does not consult the index, and running it changes no ranking or listing.

url.description: The site to check. A hostname or a full URL; https is assumed.
